name: Meridian Logistic Group
desc: Meridian Logistic Group transformed its global financial operations by replacing manual, error-prone Excel processes with Prophix. The transition enabled the logistics leader to slash close times by 71% and gain real-time visibility into cash liquidity across 14 countries.
whoText: Meridian Logistic Group is a global leader in third-party logistics, including warehousing, freight, and last-mile delivery. Headquartered in Brussels, the company manages a complex financial landscape across 14 countries with a lean team of 28 finance professionals.

krs.text: Reduced quarterly close cycle from 21 days to just 6 days.
Transformed intercompany reconciliation from an 8-day manual process to a 4-hour automated task.
Reallocated 33% of the consolidation team to high-value FP&A initiatives.
Gained real-time visibility into 12 currencies, unlocking €4.2M in previously trapped cash.

data.label: THE CHALLENGE
data.heading: Escaping the Excel Trap
data.body:
Operating across 14 countries with 47 disparate spreadsheet templates, Meridian’s finance team was trapped in a cycle of manual, heroic effort. The process was unsustainable, requiring 14-hour days for three weeks every quarter, and was plagued by high audit risk and mapping errors.

Beyond the time burden, the lack of visibility into intercompany transactions and global cash positions meant the finance team was effectively flying blind. The resulting manual workload led to staff burnout and delayed reporting that hindered board-level decision-making.

data.label: THE SOLUTION
data.heading: Automating Global Consolidation
data.body:
Meridian selected Prophix for its robust Financial Consolidation and Intercompany Management capabilities. The implementation was completed in just four months, allowing the team to move from a fragmented spreadsheet environment to a unified, automated platform.

By integrating their chart of accounts into Prophix, the team eliminated the mapping errors that had previously caused material restatements. The transition allowed the finance department to move away from data entry and toward strategic financial analysis.

data.label: THE RESULTS
data.heading: A Transformative Financial Close
data.body:
The impact was immediate: the first close on Prophix was completed in six days, a 71% improvement over their previous process. This efficiency gain allowed Meridian to redeploy two members of their consolidation team to focus on FP&A and scenario planning.

Furthermore, the treasury team gained real-time visibility into global cash positions, identifying €4.2 million in trapped cash within the first month. The board and PE sponsors now receive accurate, transparent reporting within the first week of quarter-end, a significant improvement from the previous three-week delay.

data.title: THE FIRST CLOSE
data.quote: The first close on Prophix felt like cheating. And I mean that in the best possible way.

data.title: THE HUMAN COST
data.quote: You are spending human capital on work that software should be doing, and that cost is invisible until you stop doing it.
